subject: MSA Appendix: timeboxed audit access, scoped pen-test scheduling and evidence handoff
messages:

Cc: Medsys Health Legal <legal@medsyshealth.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: audit access parameters + pen-test window for MSA appendix

Marcus — thanks for the demo last week. As we prepare to onboard Redwood as a vendor, Legal asked me to confirm the specifics of the Audit/Security Exhibit and how pen tests will be handled. Two asks from our side to avoid slowing procurement: 

1) Can you confirm whether audit rights will be timeboxed (e.g., evidence window) vs open-ended? We prefer limited windows tied to a request (e.g., 30–60 days) rather than limitless inspection rights.
2) For vendor-conducted pen tests, we need an agreed scheduling cadence and a staging environment only approach. We also require an approved vendor list and a 30-day notice window.

Attaching our standard security questionnaire and a short note on preferred clause language. If you have a redlined appendix we can review, please send over — otherwise happy to sync quickly this week.

Best,
Emily
Senior Information Security Manager
Medsys Health
[Attachment: security-questionnaire-Medsys.pdf]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Emily Roughton <emily@medsyshealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 17:28:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: audit access parameters + pen-test window for MSA appendix

Emily — thanks for the clear asks and the questionnaire. I copied Legal and Security so we can get a coordinated response. High level proposal from Redwood: 

- Timeboxed evidence window: Redwood will provide a 45-day evidence window following a written request (once per 12-month period per account, unless otherwise negotiated). Evidence includes SOC 2 summary, control descriptions, and scoped logs relevant to the customer's environment.
- Pen-test approach: Customer may engage an approved third-party vendor for a penetration test of Redwood-managed staging environments only. Requests require 30 days' notice; pen-test activity limited to a scheduled 3-business-day window. Vendors must sign our vendor NDA and follow our test rules of engagement.
- Scope narrowness: We'll accept a scoped, least-privilege evidence request — e.g., only logs and controls that directly touch the customer's data flow. We will not provide production-level host access or unrestricted access to internal source code.

I've attached a draft appendix with these points and a proposed redline for the MSA. Laura/Olga — could you review the language and suggest final legal wording? Next steps: Laura to provide final clause text and then we can circulate a DocuSign link for the appendix + order form. Proposed internal owner: Marcus Lin (security handoff) and Olga for operations scheduling.

Thanks,
Marcus
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pen-test-scope-proposal.xlsx]

Folks — I reviewed Marcus's draft and added redlines. Key legal points we should surface to Medsys: 

- Timeboxed audit right: "Customer may request access to specified evidence once per 12-month period. Redwood will provide reasonable, non-disruptive access to documented evidence and aggregation-level logs within a 45-day evidence delivery window following receipt of Customer's written request."

- Pen-test clause: "Customer may engage a third-party assessor approved in advance by Redwood; testing shall be limited to Redwood-managed non-production environments; test windows shall be scheduled with at least 30 days' notice and shall not exceed three business days. Prior to testing, the assessor must execute Redwood's testing NDA and comply with Redwood's Rules of Engagement."

- Limitations: Add explicit exclusions for on-site production access, source-code inspection, and any direct access to other customers' data.

- Evidence transfer: We will provide summarized SOC 2 report excerpts and control mappings rather than full raw logs; raw logs will only be provided with a subpoena or as otherwise required by law.

I've attached the redlined appendix (docx). I left a couple of optional softer phrases where Marcus and Ops might want operational flexibility — marked with [OPS OPTIONAL]. Please confirm acceptance so I can finalize for signature.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redlined-MSA-appendix.docx]
